meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后，当你把一段技术内容交给 Claude，它会用大白话拆出其中的谁、是什么、在哪里、为什么、什么时候，产出一份浅显易懂的说明。
howto.when: 当你表示某段技术内容太难懂、想让人用大白话讲清它的来龙去脉时，Claude 会接管这件事。

say.text: 这段东西太技术了，用大白话讲讲它的谁、什么、在哪、为什么、什么时候
say.note: Claude 会按这五个角度给出浅显说明。

say.text: 帮我用大白话拆解这份技术文档：谁做的、是什么、在哪、为何、何时
say.note: 它会套用同一套五个问题来讲解。

say.text: 把这段报错用大白话讲清楚：谁、什么、在哪、为什么、什么时候
say.note: 报错也会被拆成这五个方面。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you hand Claude something technical, it breaks it down in plain English: the who, what, where, why, and when. You get a simple explanation.
howto.when_en: Use it when you say something technical is too hard to follow and want it explained in plain English, covering the who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: That sounds mad technical. Explain the who, what, where, why, and when in plain English.
say_en.note: Claude answers along those five angles.

say_en.text: Break this technical doc into plain English: who, what, where, why, when.
Explain this error in plain English: who, what, where, why, when.
say_en.note: Errors get the same five-part breakdown.
